content.short: Cross-chain transfer app built for moving large amounts of stablecoins quickly.
content.description: StableFlow is designed for one job: moving stablecoins between chains at size. Users pick a source chain, a destination and an amount, compare the price with alternatives, and send, with the service built to handle large transfers without heavy slippage. It is one of the transfer routes available for bringing stablecoins onto Stable.
content.meta: Move large amounts of stablecoins between chains quickly and at a competitive price with StableFlow.
